verdict.rationale: Ghostty is a local terminal emulator, so retention control here means how much session output it keeps. The only relevant evidence is a community note that the default scrollback buffer (~10MB) can be changed with a config option, which gives some control over retained output. Missing for 10: documented controls for clearing or deleting scrollback and session data, any statement on whether Ghostty persists or transmits terminal data, and first-party documentation of retention settings.
